question: Does the timestep-sensitive native 20 N abort arise from changed contact impulses/duration, gripper dynamics or a joint-reaction measurement error?
source_policy: Every launch captures commit, dirty state, exact source.zip bytes/hashes, pinned upstream/installed sources, configuration, environment, commands and complete ordinary checkpoint before launch. Frozen workers and evidence stay unchanged.
cases: All 28 previously used development cases in unchanged order; no final-test access.
controller: Unchanged scripted initial insertion for exactly 60 controls/4 seconds. Instantiated frozen ordinary model preserves the reference RNG path but produces no diagnostic actions.
diagnostics: Native incoming joint reaction in documented child joint frame; raw norm unchanged.
Peg-fixture and bilateral finger vectors and native impulses.
Active-window and absorbing-window separation; contact onset, durations and integrated force magnitudes.
Gripper targets, positions, velocities, tool/held pose/velocity and sensor-body orientation.
120/240 parity against saved v3 prefixes, initialization/RNG equality, native dt and contact impulse conversion.

acceptance.prefix_gate: For adjacent finest resolutions: at most one difference in prefix abort count, at most two individual outcome changes among 28; median paired peak wrist and contact-impulse relative differences <=20%, with every outlier and exposure difference reported. Positive fixture/finger controls, native CPU replay and unchanged coarse reference must pass.
acceptance.extension: Run 960 Hz once if 240/480 fails any material outcome or load-stability margin. This is a diagnostic extension, not a claim that three timesteps prove convergence.
acceptance.training_gate: A prefix pass alone does not enable substantial training. At the selected finest stable pair rerun frozen learned direct, learned continuation and unchanged retry for complete30s jobs; no more than one completion-count difference and two individual outcome differences per arm, no forbidden events, retained force/dwell/observation contracts. Alternatively identify and independently justify a physical-model or API correction, register it, and rerun affected common controls.
acceptance.stop: Spend at most three distinct explanation-driven probe variants or two hours of simulator diagnosis after this prefix series. If no interpretable force-limited task is established, reject the current comparative-training premise for this cycle and retain a concrete numerical-sensitivity result; do not spend large training merely to produce candidate scores.

scope_and_limitations: 4-second contact diagnostic; still-active cases end probe_end and are not reported as complete30-second-job failures.
No optimizer, learned recovery actions, final tests, threshold relaxation, contact filtering substitute, within-job reset/pose write/attachment change, or convergence assertion.
Coarse initialization remains a controlled condition, not validated fully-refined initialization.
Native raw20N abort remains a simulated experiment rule, not a hardware force ceiling. Integrated loads are explanatory diagnostics only.
All native steps including absorbing and failed work are charged at eight physics-environment steps per reference transition.
